method: BB60C through the home chain (30+30+10 dB + 1 m coax, 72.8 dB at 436 MHz by path_cal 2026-11-09 10:07), measurements/2026-11-09_1009_hackrf-cal-bb60c; P0 = median of (BB60C level + 72.8 - txvga) over txvga 0-30, amp off.
